xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-5117: Flaky main CI: pan-hook-lib-guards 'pure-bash fallback' test runs real 1-3 s bash sleeps and times out under CI load

plan.title: Flaky main CI: pan-hook-lib-guards 'pure-bash fallback' test runs real 1-3 s bash sleeps and times out under CI load
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Main CI run 42862542293 failed only on tests/scripts/pan-hook-lib-guards.test.ts 'uses the pure-bash fallback when timeout commands are absent': it timed out at 5000 ms twice (first try and retry) while the sibling GNU-timeout case took 1014 ms. The case runs a real 1 s deadline around a real 3 s sleep in the default run. Planning also found a real race in the fallback watchdog of pan_run_with_timeout (sync-sources/hooks/pan-hook-lib.sh lines 165-183): when the parent kills the watchdog after a /bin/sleep forks but before sleep_pid=$! runs, the trap kills nothing and the orphaned sleep holds the caller's stdout open, so a captured call takes 6 s instead of 1 s. A widened-window copy reproduces it every time on bash 5.2 and bash 3.2.
narratives.Proposal: WI-1: change the watchdog trap to kill $(jobs -p) so every background sleep dies with the watchdog, and delete the two now-dead sleep_pid="" resets. WI-2: move the three wall-clock cases (lines 200, 227, 306) into tests/scripts/pan-hook-lib-guards.slow.test.ts with { timeout: 20_000 }; vitest.config.ts already excludes *.slow.test.ts unless VITEST_INCLUDE_SLOW=1. WI-3: add one fast default-run case that forces the fallback with an empty PATH and checks stdout and exit code. WI-4: document the *.slow.test.ts convention in docs/TESTING.md and correct the fake-timers rule, which names a nonexistent @slow tag. Full detail, before/after code, and the race probe script are in .pan/drafts/PAN-5117.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Adding tests/scripts/pan-hook-lib-guards.slow.test.ts to any CI workflow step (.github/workflows/ci.yml stays unchanged)
- Deleting pan_run_with_timeout or pan_llm_rate_check, or adding callers for them
- Changing vitest.config.ts, the CI shard layout, or the global testTimeout
- Changing the GNU timeout/gtimeout branches of pan_run_with_timeout
- Changing pan_llm_rate_check's retry count or sleep length
- Quarantining any test, or adding .skip/.only/skipIf/skip: true
- Adding a shared test-helper module for the hook lib tests

autoDecisions.summary: Fix the watchdog race in pan-hook-lib.sh in addition to moving the tests (D1).
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's acceptance requires the slow file to pass when run explicitly; an orphaned grace sleep makes the call take about 6 s, which fails the < 2_500 ms deadline assertion in either file. The mechanism was demonstrated on bash 5.2 and 3.2.

autoDecisions.summary: Use trap 'kill $(jobs -p) 2>/dev/null; exit 0' TERM INT and delete the sleep_pid="" resets (D2).
autoDecisions.rationale: jobs -p lists a job from fork time, so the trap no longer depends on sleep_pid being recorded; waited jobs leave the list on bash 5.2 and 3.2, so finished sleeps are never signalled. Redirecting watchdog stdio was rejected because it leaves orphan processes.

autoDecisions.summary: Keep the caller-less pan_run_with_timeout and pan_llm_rate_check (D3).
autoDecisions.rationale: Deleting them contradicts the issue's acceptance line and removes shipped lib code nobody asked to remove; the zero-caller fact is recorded in the codebase map concerns.md.

Rule: a case moves when its expected wall-clock time is about 1 s or more because of real sleeps or deadlines. Line 306 spends about 0.9 s in ten 0.1 s lock retries (1470 ms on CI). The lock-holder cases poll 10 ms sleeps and took under 170 ms.

autoDecisions.summary: Add one fast fallback case to the default run (D5).
autoDecisions.rationale: After the move nothing in the default run exercises the pure-bash fallback; a no-sleep case keeps CI coverage of its stdout and exit-code behavior.

autoDecisions.summary: Do not add the slow file to a CI workflow step (D8).
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue only requires the slow file to pass when run explicitly, and a workflow edit needs a token with the workflow scope.

autoDecisions.summary: Copy runBash/startBash/waitForFile into the slow file instead of a shared helper module (D9).
autoDecisions.rationale: Every tests/scripts file is self-contained; duplication is about 30 lines and keeps the default file's diff minimal.

narrative.Action: Implement PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-5117.md WI-1. In sync-sources/hooks/pan-hook-lib.sh, function pan_run_with_timeout, replace the watchdog trap line `trap '[ -n "$sleep_pid" ] && kill "$sleep_pid" 2>/dev/null; exit 0' TERM INT` with `trap 'kill $(jobs -p) 2>/dev/null; exit 0' TERM INT`, add the three-line comment from the PRD above it, and delete both `sleep_pid=""` lines that follow `wait "$sleep_pid" 2>/dev/null || exit 0`. Keep `local sleep_pid=""` and both `sleep_pid=$!` lines. Leave $(jobs -p) unquoted. Change nothing else in the file. Prove it with the probe script in the PRD, saved as .tmp/pan-5117-probe.sh (gitignored, never committed): it must fail on the pre-fix lib and pass after the fix. Do not run pan sync.
